punchline: Sandberg would give anything to have her husband back, and she still says she learned things she couldn't have learned any other way.
thirty_sec: Researchers call it post-traumatic growth: positive change after adversity, in areas like personal strength and relationships. In Option B, Sheryl Sandberg shows both sides. She would give up everything she learned to have her husband back, and she can still see what she gained. Growth, the book says, doesn't come from skipping the pain.
question: What did a hard time teach you that you might not have learned any other way?
